customers.name: Self-care and Gift Shopper
customers.description: A consumer buying premium body care, bath, home fragrance, or gift sets for personal wellbeing moments, seasonal occasions, host gifts, travel, or loved ones. Success means finding a scent-led product that feels personal, safe to buy, beautifully presented, and worth the premium.
careAbout: Discovering scent, texture, and benefit fit without being overwhelmed
Knowing whether a product works for the recipient, home, skin type, or occasion
Receiving premium presentation, gift wrap, and delivery reliability
Understanding ingredient, refill, cruelty-free, and sustainability claims
Being able to continue the routine through replenishment or refills
winsThem: Guided scent and routine discovery that feels personal
Gift recommendations by occasion, budget, recipient, and shipping deadline
Trustworthy product pages with notes, ingredients, reviews, usage guidance, and refill options
Seamless checkout, delivery promise, gift messaging, and return handling
A brand world that turns routine product use into a memorable wellbeing moment
theirFear: Choosing a scent or texture the recipient dislikes
Paying premium prices for products that feel generic or hard to justify
Late gifts, damaged packaging, missing gift wrap, or unclear return options

customers.name: Product Launch and Claims Operator
customers.description: A product, merchandising, sourcing, regulatory, or claims operator responsible for getting premium body care, bath, home fragrance, refill, and gift collections ready for market. Success means products launch on time with accurate product data, approved claims, validated refill compatibility, supplier evidence, localized content, and store execution tasks.
careAbout: Knowing which products, claims, translations, ingredients, refills, markets, and assets are ready for launch
Connecting formula, supplier, safety, and sustainability evidence to customer-facing claims
Preventing unapproved or inaccurate claims from reaching ecommerce, stores, partners, or packaging
Coordinating launch readiness across product, legal, sourcing, ecommerce, retail operations, and franchise teams
Reducing rework caused by late product data, missing evidence, market restrictions, or unclear store tasks
winsThem: A single launch readiness view across product data, claims, evidence, channels, inventory, and stores
Workflow gates that make it clear what is blocked, who owns it, and what evidence is missing
Reusable claim and ingredient evidence that can be localized without losing approval context
Structured refill compatibility and packaging data that prevents wrong-fit purchases
Store and partner tasks generated directly from approved launch scope and product content
theirFear: A collection launches with inaccurate claims, wrong ingredients, or missing market restrictions
Stores and partners receive product information too late to sell confidently
Sustainability, refill, or sourcing claims cannot be substantiated during audit or customer challenge
